title: On the Rigidity of Closed CMC Hypersurfaces in $\mathbb{S}^5(1)$ with Constant Scalar Curvature
summary: Let $M^4\hookrightarrow\mathbb S^5(1)$ be a closed CMC hypersurface with constant scalar curvature and constant third power sum $f_3=\sum_{i,j,k}h_{ij}h_{jk}h_{ki}$. We prove that if $M^4$ has exactly two distinct principal curvatures at some point, then it is isoparametric. More precisely, it is a Clifford torus of the form $\mathbb S^1(r)\times\mathbb S^3(\sqrt{1-r^2})$ or $\mathbb S^2(r)\times\mathbb S^2(\sqrt{1-r^2})$, where $0<r<1$.
